customManagers.description: The hk schema hk.pkl amends, pinned in its package URL. Grouped with the hk binary in mise.toml so both move together
squawk, pinned in the migration-lint action's install script by the marker comment above its version
firebase-tools, pinned exact in android-deploy.yml behind a renovate marker. The shared preset enables no manager for _VERSION markers, so this one reads that single file
The react-doctor version the action and its workflow default to, read from the trailing renovate marker on each default

packageRules.description: A bump to a lint tool in mise.toml or hk.pkl changes nothing callers run, so it must not cut a release
The hk binary and the hk.pkl schema version move in one PR
squawk is what migration-lint runs for every caller, so a bump changes callers and releases like any chore(deps). Listed after the custom.regex rule above so it wins
A firebase-tools bump changes what the deploy workflow runs for every caller, so unlike the other custom.regex pins it releases as chore(deps)
android-deploy.yml pins this action to a commit SHA because it runs with the signing key's service-account token, so a bump is read by a person and never merged unattended
A react-doctor bump changes what every caller's scan runs, so it must release, unlike the lint tools above. Later rules win, so this overrides ci(self-test) with the chore(deps) this repo releases on
